content_units: Family Movie Night Fit
A 90-minute family night works best with light, funny films in the   85–110 minute   range, with gentle stakes and broad humor that both kids and adults can enjoy.
Below is a ranked shortlist of   6 non-superhero movies  , all   115 minutes or less  , with quick content cautions and a snack match for each.
Ranked Family-Friendly Shortlist
Rank   Film   Year   Runtime   Why it fits   Content cautions   Snack pairing

1     Paddington     2014   95 min   Warm, genuinely funny, visually charming, and very easy for mixed ages to enjoy   Mild peril, brief bullying, some slapstick chaos   Marmalade toast bites + popcorn
2     The Emperor’s New Groove     2000   78 min   Fast, goofy, quotable, and surprisingly funny for adults too   Cartoon peril, a few scary chase moments   Cheese quesadilla wedges + churro bites
3     School of Rock     2003   109 min   High-energy, funny, music-driven, and very parent-friendly   Mild rude humor, some school rule-breaking, light language   Mini pizzas + guitar-pick cookies

4     Chicken Run     2000   84 min   Clever jokes, quick pace, and strong appeal for both kids and grown-ups   Mild suspense, farm animals threatened by pie machine   Chicken-free nuggets + veggie sticks

5     Fantastic Mr. Fox     2009   87 min   Dry, smart humor with enough adventure to hold adults and older kids   Stylized animal violence, stealing themes, a few tense scenes   Trail mix cups + cider

6     A Shaun the Sheep Movie     2015   85 min   Very gentle, visual comedy, almost no dialogue fatigue, easy group watch   Very mild peril, brief sad/lost moments   Crackers, cheese, and fruit skewers
Best Pick for Your Group
1) Paddington   Sweetest all-around win   95 min
- Best balance of   kid-safe  ,   funny  , and   adult-friendly  .
- The humor is gentle but clever, and the pace suits both an 8- and 11-year-old.
- Good choice if you want the least risk of anyone getting bored or overwhelmed.
Watch trailer
2) The Emperor’s New Groove   Biggest laugh-per-minute pick   78 min
- Ideal if you want something   short, silly, and energetic  .
- Very easy movie-night choice when attention spans may dip.
- Best for a low-commitment, high-fun evening.
Watch trailer
3) School of Rock   Best if the adults want more too   109 min
- Strongest cross-age appeal if your family likes music and performance comedy.
- Slightly older-kid tone, but still broadly family-friendly.
- Best if the 11-year-old wants something a bit more grown-up without being intense.
Watch trailer
Movie Night Setup That Fits 90 Minutes
If you want to stay close to a 90-minute window
-   Exact best fit:    Paddington  (95),  Fantastic Mr. Fox  (87),  Shaun the Sheep Movie  (85),  Chicken Run  (84)
-   Shortest/easiest night:    The Emperor’s New Groove  (78)
- If you include trailers, snack setup, and settling in, the sub-90-minute picks will feel most comfortable.
Family Viewing Notes
Context for the shortlist
- Prioritized:   funny first  , then   low intensity  , then   adult appeal
- Excluded: superhero films, heavier emotional stories, and anything   over 115 minutes
